seoTitle: GTIN Check Digit Calculator for EAN-13, UPC-A and EAN-8
metaDescription: Compute or validate the GS1 check digit for EAN-13, UPC-A, EAN-8 and GTIN-14 numbers, one per line. Free and private.
intro: Computes the last digit of a barcode number or checks whether a full number is valid.
why:
A mistyped barcode number is a common cause of rejected listings. The last digit is a check digit calculated from the others with alternating weights of 3 and 1, so most single-digit errors are caught.

Paste numbers one per line. Seven or eleven digits get a check digit; eight, twelve, thirteen or fourteen digits are checked. A twelve digit number is shown both as an EAN-13 payload and as a full UPC-A. A valid check digit does not mean the number is assigned to your product.
howTo: Read the check digit or the validity of each.
Fix the digits that fail and run again.

faq.q: Does a valid number mean the product is registered?
faq.a: No. It only means the check digit fits. Numbers must be issued by GS1 or a reseller.

faq.q: Why is a 12 digit number shown twice?
faq.a: It could be the start of an EAN-13 or a complete UPC-A.
Use the Barcode Generator for that.
